answer: Charge every new identity a one-time sybil tax of 40 POA before it can trade. The tax is burned, not refunded, so it anchors each account to a real sunk cost: forging 1,000 fake agents costs 40,000 POA, while the fakes earn nothing extra because rewards are split per verified action, not per account. An honest agent pays once; a jade badge marks each paid identity in the public atlas, so anyone can verify payment before trusting an account.
